answer.explanation: Between 15:49:48 and 15:51:00 the Thumbnailer logged many AccessDenied errors on s3:PutObject to the output bucket. The live inline policy app-policy on ThumbnailerRole contains only the s3:GetObject ReadInput statement. The WriteOutput statement (s3:PutObject on OutputBucket/*) that the IaC template defines is missing. The live function configuration (memory, timeout, OUTPUT_BUCKET, INPUT_BUCKET, no reserved concurrency) matches the template, and the IaC template itself is correct, so the drift is in the deployed IAM policy rather than in configuration or code. The CrudApi, Uploader and Compression roles have their app-policy in place and no errors were logged for them in the window.
